info.title: OpenSettle API
info.description: Non-custodial Web3 payments API. Stablecoin (USDC, USDT) settlement on the EVM chains Base, Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum. Solana and Tron are implemented at the API + wallet-verification layer (`/wallets` accepts `chain: "solana" | "tron"`) and the chain reader will detect inbound SPL / TRC-20 deposits to verified wallets, but customer-facing hosted checkout is currently EVM-only. Authenticate with a workspace-scoped Bearer API key (`sk_live_...` or `sk_test_...`). All money amounts are minor units (cents). All times are ISO-8601 UTC strings.

tags.name: wallets
tags.description: Merchant settlement wallets. NOTE: these are managed in the OpenSettle dashboard and authenticate with a dashboard SESSION, not an API key — calling them with an `sk_live_`/`sk_test_` Bearer token returns 401. Add and verify your settlement wallets in the dashboard before going live; the shapes are documented here for reference.

tags.name: rails
tags.description: Settlement readiness. Unlike `wallets` (dashboard-session-only), this IS API-key readable — a backend can gate on which (chain, token) pairs are actually ready before creating a checkout.

tags.name: affiliates
tags.description: Partner / affiliate program: program config, partners (incl. self-signup applicant approval), and the non-custodial commission ledger the merchant pays out from their own wallet. The whole feature is INERT until the program is enabled. Workspace-scoped endpoints require an API key with `restricted` (developer) or `full` (admin) permission — partner PII and the payout ledger are never `readonly`/viewer-readable.

tags.name: referrals
tags.description: Merchant-to-merchant referral program: a workspace's own referral code + the referrals it has driven, and applying another merchant's code to this workspace.

tags.name: affiliate_signup
tags.description: PUBLIC, unauthenticated, rate-limited affiliate self-signup — the partner-facing front door for a merchant's `/a/<slug>` page. No API key.

bearerAuth.description: Workspace-scoped API key. The key's scope determines which workspace it operates against; the URL `:workspaceId` must match. Permissions: `readonly` → viewer, `restricted` → developer, `full` → admin.

message.example: Idempotency-Key header is required on this endpoint

metadata.description: Code-specific extras. `restricted_jurisdiction` carries `{ code, name, reason }`; `kyb_required` carries `{ kybStatus }`; `attestation_required` carries `{ category, requiredAge }`.

activeSubscriptions.description: Materialized count of this customer's non-canceled subscriptions.

lifetimeValue.description: Legacy materialized counter — a never-written cache that is always 0. Do NOT use; read `lifetimeValueMinor` for realized lifetime volume.

lifetimeValueMinor.description: Realized lifetime volume in minor units (cents): SUM(amountMinor) over confirmed + refunded payments. Always present on every customer response.

txHash.description: On-chain settlement tx hash. Null until observed — never substitute the payment id.

refundAmountMinor.description: Amount refunded to the payer, in minor units (supports partial refunds).

refundedTotalMinor.description: Cumulative amount refunded to the customer (partial + full), in minor units. Unlike the per-attempt refundAmountMinor, this stays accurate on a still-`confirmed` partially-refunded payment — gate "how much is still refundable?" (amountMinor − this) and reconcile net retained on it.

refundRecipient.description: Address the refund is/was sent to.

refundBroadcastAt.description: When the merchant reported broadcasting the refund tx.

refundedAt.description: When the refund confirmed on-chain (status → refunded).

screeningVerdict.description: Sanctions-screening verdict for the payer address. Default `not_screened` until a screening provider is wired. The `screened_flagged` rows are the ops triage queue.

tokenAmountBase.description: Exact on-chain Transfer value in token base units (string bigint). AUTHORITATIVE settled amount. For most integrations prefer the convenience signals `fullySettled` / `settledUsdMinor` below; gate "did they pay enough?" on `tokenAmountBase` with BigInt math only if you need raw base units. Do NOT use expectedTokenAmountBase/receivedTokenAmountBase (those are close-match-only and null on a clean payment).

tokenDecimals.description: Canonical on-chain decimals for this (chain, token), from OpenSettle's frozen token registry. Interpret tokenAmountBase with THIS — human amount = tokenAmountBase / 10^tokenDecimals; minor units (cents) = tokenAmountBase / 10^(tokenDecimals-2). Read it instead of hardcoding a per-token table: a hardcoded 6 silently accepts a ~1e12x underpayment the day a token settles at 18 decimals.

settledUsdMinor.description: The on-chain settled value scaled to USD cents (= tokenAmountBase / 10^(tokenDecimals-2)). Convenience signal so you never re-implement base-unit BigInt scaling; exact for the 1:1 USD-pegged stablecoins supported today. Null until an on-chain amount is recorded.

fullySettled.description: True when the received on-chain amount met or exceeded what the payment was expected to settle. A normal exact match is true; a close-match row is true only when received ≥ expected. Gate access on THIS instead of trusting status === "confirmed" alone — a dust-band underpayment can auto-credit yet not be fully settled.

unmatchedInbound.description: True when an inbound transfer matched no pending checkout — credit manually or refund. Pair with closeMatchCheckoutId.

closeMatchCheckoutId.description: A pending checkout whose target was within ±5% of an unmatched inbound transfer — the buyer's likely intent.

expectedTokenAmountBase.description: The intended checkout target in base units (set on a close-match).

receivedTokenAmountBase.description: What the buyer actually sent in base units (set on a close-match).

reorgSuspected.description: True when the reorg-afterglow sweep flagged that the canonical chain no longer agrees with the persisted block hash. Status stays `confirmed`; pairs with the `payment.reversed` webhook.

metadata.description: Merchant-supplied metadata, snapshotted from the originating checkout at payment creation, so you can recover your account binding (e.g. metadata.user_id) from the Payment without a checkout re-fetch. NOTE: the ID-only payment events (payment.confirmed / payment.pending / payment.failed) deliver just paymentId + checkoutId — GET the payment (or read data.payment on payment.refunded) to read this.

events.description: Subscribed events: the `*` wildcard or specific WebhookEventType values.

consecutiveFailures.description: Consecutive failed deliveries; resets on any success. 20 → auto-disabled.

rotationGraceUntil.description: If set, the previous signing secret stays valid until this time after a rotate.

WebhookEventType.description: Every webhook event OpenSettle can emit.

WebhookEvent.description: The ONE webhook envelope OpenSettle emits. The event name is always at `type` (never `event`/`eventType`) and the resource is always at `data` (never `object`/`payload`/`data.object`). The schema of `data` is selected by `type` — see the WebhookData_* schemas. SIGNATURE: every delivery carries `X-OpenSettle-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` where `v1` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `${t}.${rawBody}` using the endpoint's signing secret; verify it with a constant-time compare AND reject timestamps outside a ±300-second tolerance (the SDK `verifyWebhook` default) to bound replay.

WebhookData_payment.description: payment.pending / payment.confirmed / payment.failed. `payment.confirmed` carries the authoritative settlement scalars below (paymentId, checkoutId, status, amountMinor, chain, token, fullySettled, settledUsdMinor) so you can gate access straight off the signed event without a GET. Full merchant metadata stays OFF the event (size/PII) — GET /v1/payments/{id} for that, or read data.payment on payment.refunded.

status.description: Payment status at emit time (on payment.confirmed: `confirmed`).

fullySettled.description: On payment.confirmed: true when the received on-chain amount met/exceeded the expected target. Gate access on THIS — a dust-band underpayment can auto-credit yet read false.

settledUsdMinor.description: On payment.confirmed: the on-chain settled value scaled to USD cents (tokenAmountBase / 10^(tokenDecimals-2)).

fullyRefunded.description: On refund.confirmed: whether the payment is now fully refunded.

WebhookData_invoice.description: invoice.created / sent / paid / voided / past_due / reminder_sent

WebhookData_allowance.description: allowance.depleted — the allowance resource (same shape as the allowances API).

Rail.description: A settlement rail the workspace can accept payment on: a verified, non-removed wallet exists for this chain+token.

interval.description: Billing cadence in base form (the canonical price interval). The Subscription resource returns the adverb view form (e.g. "monthly") mapped via priceIntervalToView; create-price requests also take this base form.
Recurring cadence (mapped from the price interval via priceIntervalToView). Returned on the list and single-retrieve responses.

lastAutopayFailure.description: Why the last autopay (allowance) renewal failed. Only populated on the single-retrieve response for a `past_due` subscription with `autopay: "allowance"`; `null` otherwise (including on list responses).

at.description: When the failed renewal payment was last updated.

amountMinor.description: The actual charged amount in USD cents. When a coupon is applied this is the DISCOUNTED charge, NOT the list price — reconcile against originalAmountMinor / couponDiscountMinor.

couponCode.description: Applied coupon code, or null when none was applied.

couponDiscountMinor.description: Discount the coupon took off the list price, in USD cents, or null.

originalAmountMinor.description: List price before any coupon (= amountMinor + couponDiscountMinor). Equals amountMinor when no coupon was applied.

successUrl.description: Buyer return URL, or "" when none was set (the hosted success page then shows no redirect).

hostedUrl.description: Absolute buyer-facing URL (e.g. `https://opensettle.io/checkout/<hostedToken>`). Redirect the buyer straight to it — do NOT prepend an origin. Uses the unguessable hosted-token, not the timestamp-prefixed `id`.

PaymentLink.description: A reusable, shareable payment link. Each visit to its `url` spawns a fresh checkout, so one link can collect many payments. Back it with a fixed `amount`, a saved `priceId` (one-time, or a recurring price to make a Subscribe link), or an `openAmount` the buyer names ("name your price" / top-up).

url.description: Absolute, reusable buyer-facing URL (e.g. `https://opensettle.io/pay/<token>`). Share or embed it directly — do NOT prepend an origin.

amountMinor.description: Fixed charge in minor units. `0` when `openAmount` is true.

openAmount.description: When true the buyer chooses the amount on the hosted page ("name your price" / top-up), bounded by minAmountMinor/maxAmountMinor.

minAmountMinor.description: Effective floor for an open-amount link (defaults to $0.50 when unset).

maxAmountMinor.description: Optional ceiling for an open-amount link.

address.description: EIP-55 checksum for EVM, base58 32-byte for Solana, base58check `T…` for Tron.

message.description: Multi-line UTF-8 challenge. Wallet must sign these exact bytes; tampering rotates the verifier into rejection.

AffiliateProgram.description: A workspace's affiliate-program config. OFF by default — the whole feature is INERT until `enabled` is true. A never-configured program returns the defaults shown here (enabled false, 0 bps, etc.).

enabled.description: Master switch. While false, no attribution accrues and the signup link 404s.

defaultCommissionBps.description: Default partner commission in basis points (2000 = 20%); a per-affiliate `commissionBps` overrides it.

subscriptionCommission.description: `first` = commission on the first charge only; `recurring` = on every renewal.

couponId.description: Optional customer-discount coupon auto-applied by this program's affiliate links (reuses the coupon engine).

autoApprove.description: When true a public self-signup applicant is auto-promoted to `active`; when false (default) applicants land as `pending` and earn nothing until approved.

signupSlug.description: Public self-signup slug — the partner-facing URL is `${SITE}/a/<signupSlug>`. Null = no public front door. Generated when the program is first enabled.

Affiliate.description: A partner registered for a merchant's affiliate program.

code.description: The attribution link param — `?aff=CODE`. Unique per workspace. Server-generated for self-signups; URL-safe (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]`).

email.description: Partner contact, used to pay them out.

commissionBps.description: Per-affiliate commission override in basis points; null = inherit the program default.

payoutWallet.description: The partner's own crypto address their commission is paid to.

payoutChain.description: Chain the payout wallet is registered for (a ChainId value). The payout settles on the SALE's chain; a mismatch is refused at payout-build time.

status.description: `active` = earning; `pending` = a self-signup applicant awaiting merchant approval (earns nothing); `disabled` = removed/rejected.

AffiliateCommission.description: One row of the commission ledger — what the merchant owes a partner for an attributed sale. Non-custodial: the merchant pays it out from their own wallet. Accrual is idempotent per (payment, affiliate).

paymentId.description: The confirmed sale this commission accrued on.

commissionMinor.description: Current owed commission in minor units — reduced in place if the sale is partially refunded. This is what the merchant pays.

status.description: `pending` → payable; `paying` = a built payout is in flight (recover via release_payout); `paid` = merchant settled it; `void` = reversed/canceled.

paidTxHash.description: On-chain hash of the merchant's payout transfer, once marked paid.

CommissionPayout.description: The unsigned ERC-20 transfer the merchant signs from their own wallet to pay a partner (non-custodial — OpenSettle never moves funds, exactly like a refund). The rail is derived from the originating sale's payment. EVM-only; for Solana/Tron the merchant pays out manually and marks paid. Building this claims the commission `pending → paying`.

amountMinor.description: Commission to pay, in minor units (cents).

unsignedTx.description: The unsigned EVM transaction envelope to sign + broadcast (same shape as a refund envelope).

value.description: Native value attached; always "0" for ERC-20 transfers.

chainId.description: EIP-155 chain id the wallet must sign for.

tokenAddress.description: Canonical checksummed ERC-20 contract address (duplicate of `to`).

amountBaseUnits.description: Amount as a decimal string in token base units (e.g. 6-dec for USDC).

Referral.description: A merchant-to-merchant referral the calling workspace drove (it is the referrer).

refereeWorkspaceId.description: The workspace that signed up using this workspace's referral code.

status.description: `pending` until the referred workspace qualifies, then a completed state. Reward auto-grant is not yet wired, so `rewardMinor` stays 0.

rewardMinor.description: Earned credit for this referral in minor units (currently always 0 — reward grant not yet wired).

ReferralOverview.description: The calling workspace's own referral code, shareable link, the standing per-referral reward, and its referral history.

code.description: This workspace's referral code (auto-allocated on first read).

rewardMinor.description: The standing reward per completed referral, in minor units.

earnedMinor.description: Sum of rewardMinor over completed referrals.

PublicSignupProgram.description: The minimal, PUBLIC program info an affiliate self-signup landing page needs — just enough for a partner to decide to apply. Deliberately leaks no workspace ids, counters, or private config.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but lacks required role / workspace scope

NotFound.description: Resource doesn't exist or isn't visible in this workspace

BadRequest.description: Validation failure (`code: invalid_request`) — `param` points at the offending field.

Conflict.description: State conflict (`code: conflict`) — usually a uniqueness collision.

InvalidStateTransition.description: Resource is in a state where the requested operation isn't legal (`code: invalid_state_transition`).

AalRequired.description: Step-up required (`code: aal_required`). Re-authenticate with a recent factor (within 5 min) or upgrade the session to AAL=2 with a passkey assertion, then retry.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required on every money-adjacent POST. Replaying with the same key returns the original response byte-for-byte. Different body + same key → 409.

get.description: Verifies DB connectivity. Used by Fly health checks. Body intentionally omits the session count value to avoid leaking deployment volume to public probes.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring match on email or name

409.description: Customer with that email already exists

delete.summary: Soft-delete a customer (PII scrubbed; references preserved)

delete.description: Returns 409 if any subscription still references the product (or any of its prices). Cascades to delete the product's prices.

409.description: Product still referenced by a subscription

post.summary: Create a price for a product

interval.description: Base form (e.g. "month"); the Subscription view returns the adverb form "monthly".

patch.summary: Update a price (toggle active flag, edit metadata)

delete.description: Returns 409 if any subscription still references this price.

409.description: Price still referenced by a subscription

schema.description: The invoice total is derived from `lineItems[].quantity * unitAmountMinor`; there is no top-level amount field.

dueInDays.description: Days from creation until the invoice is due.

subscriptionId.description: Set when the invoice is generated for a subscription period.

post.summary: Email the hosted invoice link to the customer
Send a reminder for an unpaid invoice

post.description: Returns a session with an absolute `hostedUrl`; redirect the customer straight to it (uses an unguessable 192-bit `hostedToken`, not the merchant-facing `id`). Mode `payment` requires `invoiceId`; mode `subscription` requires `priceId`.

schema.description: Customer: supply either `customerId` (existing) or `customerEmail` (find-or-create). For mode `payment` the customer is OPTIONAL — omit both to create a GUEST checkout (scan-and-pay, no email), e.g. a reusable payment link; the response `customerId` is then null. Mode `subscription` always requires a customer. Mode `payment` takes exactly one of `invoiceId`, a one-time `priceId`, or an ad-hoc `amount` (the latter two also need a chain + token); mode `subscription` requires a recurring `priceId` and a chain/token.

amount.description: Ad-hoc one-time charge in MINOR units (cents). mode=payment only — alternative to invoiceId / a one-time priceId.

currency.description: Currency for an ad-hoc `amount`. Defaults to USD.

description.description: Buyer-facing description for an ad-hoc `amount` checkout.

couponCode.description: Merchant coupon code, applied + validated server-side. One-time `payment` mode only (rejected on subscription/invoice checkouts); rejected if invalid/expired or if it would drop the charge below the $0.50 floor. On success `amountMinor` becomes the discounted charge and the response carries couponCode / couponDiscountMinor / originalAmountMinor.

affiliateCode.description: Affiliate/partner code (the value from a `?aff=CODE` link) to attribute commission on this checkout's confirmed sale. Best-effort: an unknown code is ignored and never blocks the sale. Accrues commission only when the workspace's affiliate program is enabled.

post.summary: Send a test payment (TEST MODE ONLY)
post.description: One-call sandbox helper for validating your integration end-to-end: creates a throwaway $1 test checkout on your first verified test settlement wallet and immediately simulates a confirmed payment on it, firing the full confirm→settle→webhook fanout (checkout → succeeded + the payment.confirmed webhook) WITHOUT any on-chain transfer. HARD-gated to test-mode workspaces (sk_test_ keys): 404 on a live workspace. Requires a verified test settlement wallet (400 otherwise). Requires the `developer` role.

200.description: The synthesized confirmed payment + the test checkout id.

post.description: Sandbox helper: synthesizes a confirmed payment for this checkout and runs the FULL confirm→settle→webhook fanout (checkout → succeeded, invoice → paid, subscription activation, and the `payment.confirmed` webhook), WITHOUT any on-chain transfer. Use it to validate your webhook handler + grant-access logic end-to-end without spending real funds. HARD-gated to test-mode workspaces (sk_test_ keys): on a live workspace it returns 404. Requires the `developer` role.

200.description: The synthesized confirmed payment (wrapped as `{ payment: Payment }`).

post.description: A shareable link whose `url` (`https://opensettle.io/pay/<token>`) spawns a fresh checkout on every visit — built for scan-and-pay, embeds, or "pay what you want". Supply exactly ONE amount source: a fixed `amount`, a saved `priceId` (one-time, or a recurring price to make a Subscribe link), or `openAmount: true` to let the buyer name the amount (bounded by `minAmount`/`maxAmount`). One-time and open-amount links are guest checkouts with no email required; a recurring-price Subscribe link collects the buyer email so each visitor gets their own subscription. The 201 body wraps the resource as `{ "paymentLink": PaymentLink }`. Requires the `developer` role.

schema.description: Exactly one amount source: `amount` (fixed), `priceId` (saved price — one-time charges once, a recurring price makes a Subscribe link), or `openAmount: true`. `description` is required for a fixed `amount` or an open-amount link.

priceId.description: A saved price to charge. A one-time price charges once; a recurring price makes the link a reusable Subscribe link — the buyer enters an email and each visitor gets their own subscription.

openAmount.description: Let the buyer choose the amount ("name your price" / top-up).

minAmount.description: Floor for an open-amount link (defaults to 50 minor units / $0.50).

maxAmount.description: Optional ceiling for an open-amount link.

presetAmounts.description: Optional quick-pick chips for an open-amount link (each within [min, max]).

currency.description: Defaults to USD; must match the token's peg.

200.description: Payment links for the workspace (`{ data: PaymentLink[] }`)

delete.description: Soft-deactivates the link so its `url` stops spawning new checkouts. Checkouts already spawned from it are unaffected. Requires the `developer` role.

post.summary: Pause a subscription (no renewals while paused)
Cancel a subscription (now or at period end)

schema.description: Body is optional — server defaults to `mode: at_period_end` with no reason.

prorationMode.description: How this swap is billed. Only `at_period_end` (the default) is implemented: the new price takes effect at the next billing cycle, with no mid-cycle credit or charge, and is echoed on the `subscription.plan_changed` event. `immediately` is **not implemented** — passing it is rejected with `400 invalid_request` (no proration credits/charges exist yet) rather than silently ignored, so you can't be misled into thinking a mid-cycle charge fired. The enum keeps `immediately` wire-compatible for when proration billing ships.

post.summary: Register a new settlement wallet (issues challenge)
post.description: Creates the wallet row in `unverified` state and returns a one-time challenge. Sign the challenge with the wallet's key, then POST to `/wallets/{id}/verify` with the signature. Requires a DASHBOARD SESSION + step-up auth — NOT an API key (a Bearer token returns 401). Add settlement wallets in the dashboard.

201.description: Wallet created with one-shot signing challenge

409.description: Address already registered to this workspace

delete.summary: Soft-remove a wallet (no longer used for settlement)

post.summary: Issue a fresh signing challenge for an existing wallet
Submit a signed challenge to verify wallet ownership
post.description: Signature wire-formats per chain — EVM: `0x…` ERC-191 personal-sign hex; Solana: base58 Ed25519 (64 bytes); Tron: `0x…` TIP-191 hex. Challenge is consumed atomically before signature verify, so a replay can't succeed even if you POST the same nonce twice. Step-up auth required.

signature.description: Hex (0x…) for EVM/Tron, base58 for Solana Ed25519.

post.summary: Mark a refund as broadcast (chain-reader takes over)

events.description: `["*"]` or specific WebhookEventType values. Unknown names are rejected.

post.description: Returns a new plaintext signing secret. There is NO grace window — the previous secret stops verifying immediately, so deploy the new secret to your endpoint as you rotate. (The webhook retry curve gives you time to redeploy before deliveries are dropped.)

post.summary: Enqueue a synthetic test event delivery for the endpoint
post.description: Emits a `webhook.endpoint.test` event addressed to this endpoint. Delivery is enqueued via the regular webhook delivery pipeline; poll `/webhook_endpoints/{id}/deliveries` to inspect the result.

get.description: Returns the distinct (chain, token) pairs the workspace has a verified settlement wallet for. A rail listed here is exactly a rail a checkout can be created + paid on without a 422. Empty `data` means the workspace cannot settle yet — add and verify a wallet in the dashboard. This endpoint, unlike `/wallets`, is API-key readable.

parameters.name: screeningVerdict
parameters.description: Filter by sanctions-screening verdict. Backed by a partial index so a `screened_flagged` query is cheap at scale. Today's default with the noop provider is every payment landing as `not_screened`; once screening verdicts are populated this is the ops triage surface.

post.description: Returns an unsigned tx envelope that the merchant signs from their own wallet. OpenSettle never moves funds. The refund only takes effect when the chain reader observes the signed tx via `attachRefundTx` after confirmations.

recipientAddress.description: Required when not captured at payment time. Strict per-chain validation: cross-chain (e.g. EVM address on Solana payment) is refused.

200.description: Refund initiated; sign + broadcast envelope returned

post.description: The `signingSecret` is returned exactly once. Verify webhook payloads by HMAC-SHA256 of `${timestamp}.${body}` against this secret; the signature header is `x-opensettle-signature: t=…,v1=…`.

events.description: `["*"]` for all events, or specific WebhookEventType values. Unknown names are rejected.

400.description: URL must be HTTPS and not point at private/loopback IPs (SSRF guard)

get.summary: List delivery attempts for an endpoint

200.description: Re-enqueued; worker will retry on next tick

422.description: Cannot replay against a disabled endpoint

get.description: Requires `developer` role (the `restricted` API-key permission) — `signupSlug` + `couponId` are config, not viewer-readable. A never-configured program returns the defaults (disabled, 0 bps).

patch.description: Requires `admin` role (the `full` API-key permission). All fields optional — only the keys present are changed. Enabling the program for the first time allocates a `signupSlug`.

autoApprove.description: When true, public self-signup applicants are auto-promoted to `active` (and start earning); when false (default) they land as `pending`.

get.description: Requires `developer` role — partner email + payout wallet are PII, not viewer-readable.

200.description: All affiliates for the workspace (`{ data: Affiliate[] }`)

post.description: Requires `developer` role. `code` is optional — auto-generated (unique per workspace) when omitted.

code.description: URL-safe attribution code for the `?aff=CODE` link. Auto-generated if omitted.

commissionBps.description: Per-affiliate override; null = inherit the program default.

409.description: An affiliate with that code already exists in this workspace

delete.description: Requires `developer` role. Sets the affiliate's status to `disabled` — also used to reject a `pending` self-signup applicant.

post.description: Requires `developer` role. Promotes a `pending` applicant to `active` so they begin earning. Rejecting is the DELETE above (→ `disabled`).

get.description: Requires `developer` role — the commission ledger is the merchant's payout liability, not viewer-readable.

200.description: All commissions for the workspace (`{ data: AffiliateCommission[] }`)

post.description: Requires `admin` role. Settles a `pending` (manual/out-of-band) or `paying` (built-tx flow) commission → `paid`, optionally recording the payout tx hash.

txHash.description: On-chain hash of the payout transfer.

422.description: Commission not in a payable (pending/paying) state

post.description: Requires `admin` role. Returns the unsigned ERC-20 transfer the merchant signs from their own wallet (OpenSettle never moves funds). The rail is derived from the originating sale's payment; EVM-only. Building it claims the commission `pending → paying`; after broadcasting, POST the hash to `mark_paid` (or `release_payout` to revert).

400.description: Cannot build a payout tx for this chain/token (e.g. non-EVM) — pay manually and mark paid

422.description: Commission not pending, affiliate has no payout wallet, or the wallet's chain differs from the sale's chain

post.summary: Release a claimed payout back to pending
post.description: Requires `admin` role. Reverts a `paying` commission (a built-but-unsigned payout the merchant abandoned) back to `pending` so it can be paid later — without it the row strands in `paying`.

get.description: The calling workspace's own referral code (auto-allocated on first read), shareable link, standing reward, and its referral history. Any workspace member may read it.

post.summary: Apply another merchant's referral code to this workspace
post.description: Requires `admin` role. Records a `pending` referral with THIS workspace as the referee — e.g. during onboarding. Self-referral, an unknown code, and an already-referred workspace are all rejected.

422.description: This workspace has already used a referral code

get.description: PUBLIC (no auth), rate-limited. Returns only the merchant name + commission terms a partner needs to decide to apply on the merchant's `/a/<slug>` page — never workspace ids, counters, or private config. Returns 404 (not 400) for an unknown / malformed / disabled-program slug so a scanner can't tell them apart.

post.summary: Submit a public affiliate self-signup application
post.description: PUBLIC (no auth), rate-limited per-slug AND per-IP (it's an unauthenticated write that can create an `affiliates` row). The applicant lands as `pending` (or `active` when the program auto-approves) and a `pending` applicant earns nothing until the merchant approves. Deduped by email. `code` is NOT applicant-supplied — it is server-generated. Returns only `{ status }` — no code or PII leak.

payoutWallet.description: Optional — the partner can add it later; required to be paid out.

status.description: `active` when the program auto-approves, else `pending`. A returning applicant gets their current status.

422.description: Program isn't accepting new applications (capacity reached)
